message.content:
The square has side length \(500\) meters, so the circle inscribed in it has diameter \(500\) meters, and radius:

\[
r = 250
\]

Area of the square:

\[
500^2 = 250000
\]

Area of the circular watered field:

\[
\pi r^2 = \pi(250)^2 = 62500\pi \approx 196350
\]

Area not watered:

\[
250000 - 196350 = 53650
\]

Rounded to the nearest thousand square meters:

\[
53650 \approx 54000
\]

The answer is 54000 square meters.
